set.body:
Objective
Either keep ravel-laws internal or turn it into a genuine downstream conformance kit; do not publish constant properties as a stable laws artifact.

Acceptance criteria
- The core 1.0 publication decision for ravel-laws is explicit and enforced in the build.
- If internal, helpers move to nonpublished testkit scope and no public compatibility promise is made.
- If public, laws are parameterized by a downstream adapter and generate ranks, empty axes, layouts, dtypes, ownership forms, floating edge values, overflow boundaries, and invalid inputs.
- Public Discipline RuleSets cover shape, views, traversal, alias isolation, broadcasting, reductions, casting, mutation, and interop.
- A fresh downstream project executes the RuleSets against published artifacts.
- The module is not labeled stable until the selected path is complete.
set.title: EPIC: Decide and build the honest ravel-laws contract
